description: Ten self-authored procedural test patterns. Historical filenames are stable test labels, not photographs or reproductions of artwork.

generator.randomness: Fixed integer coordinate hash and per-pattern seeds; no external inputs.
generator.encoding: 8-bit RGBA PNG, filter zero, stored DEFLATE; deterministic bytes without external packages.
